examples.arabic: خالتي قالتلي ان في مرشح جديد للانتخابات الكل بيتكلم عنه
examples.english: My aunt told me there's a new candidate for the elections everyone is talking about
examples.transliteration: Khaltī qāletlī inn fī morashshaḥ gedīd lel-entikhābāt el-koll biyitkallem ʿannoh

examples.arabic: قالت لي صباح الخير يا استاذ عامل ايه سمعت ان في مرشح جديد جاي المنطقة
examples.english: She told me "Good morning, teacher, how are you? I heard there's a new candidate coming to the area."
examples.transliteration: Qāletli "Sabāḥ el-khēr ya ostāz ʿāmel ēh? Semeʿt en fī morashshaḥ gedīd gāy el-minṭaqa."

examples.arabic: قالتلي ان فيه مرشح جديد عجبها اوي وانه ممكن يكسب بالتصويت
examples.english: She told me there's a new candidate she really likes and that he might win by voting.
examples.transliteration: Qāletli en fīh morashshaḥ gedīd ʿagabha awi w'ennaho mumkin yeksab bet-taṣwīt.

examples.arabic: بدأت احضر المكونات بعناية وكل مرشح من التوابل كان لازم يتوزن صح
examples.english: I started preparing the ingredients carefully, and every candidate spice had to be weighed correctly.
examples.transliteration: Badaʾt aḥaḍḍar el-mokawwenat beʿenaya we koll morashshaḥ men et-tawabel kan lazim yetwazen saḥḥ.

examples.arabic: قررنا نعمل تصويت عشان نختار مرشح يصلحها
examples.english: We decided to hold a vote to choose a candidate to fix it.
examples.transliteration: Qararnā naʿmal taṣwīt ʿashān nekhtār morashshaḥ yoṣleḥha.
